player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_rounds} round game of Iterated Stag Hunt.

Game Structure:
- The game consists of {decision_rounds} decision rounds
- Before each decision, you have {conversation_rounds} turns to communicate
- After communication, both players simultaneously choose to hunt a Stag or Hare

Rewards:
- The rewards associated with hunting stags and hares may differ between rounds
- The rewards are presented at the start of each round

How to Play:
- During communication: Simply type your message
- During decision phase: Use '[Stag]' or '[Hare]'
You can include additional text before or after these tokens.

round.payoff_matrix:
Starting Round {round} with payoff matrix:
- Both hunt a Stag: Both get {mutual_stag} points
- Both hunt a Hare: Both get {mutual_hare} points
- One hunts a Hare, One hunts a Stag: The hunter of the Hare gets {single_hare} points, the hunter of the Stag gets {single_stag} points
You can freely communicate with your opponent for {conversation_rounds} rounds before making a decision.
round.decision_phase: The decision phase for round {round} has started. Please reply with either '[stag]' or '[hare]'.
round.results:
Round {round} complete. Results:
	Player 0 picked '{decision0}' (payoff: {payoff0}; total: {total0})
	Player 1 picked '{decision1}' (payoff: {payoff1}; total: {total1})

outcome.win:
Final scores: Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}
Player {winner_id} won!
outcome.draw:
